tools.name: dubstep-gunsmith-20261012.json
tools.description: Catalog third-party creator gun assets with reference videos, clear stills, credits and source links. Plan separate avatar loadouts and record known or unknown resource costs, then export a loadout manifest for reviewed Unity setup.
tools.command_template: Open https://dubstep-gunsmith.audra-volk-1606.chatgpt.site (owner-private). Export planned loadouts; Unity companion setup requires explicit prefab mapping.
requirements: Acquire required assets from their creators and preserve their source references.
limitations: Catalog stores records in this browser; use JSON exports for backup or transfer.
Removing an item from an avatar plan preserves the catalog entry.
Cost totals are reported estimates and unknown counts, not a VRChat performance rating.
No direct Unity connection. The website alone does not change a scene.
Unverified reference credits and names are kept separate from verified creator sales listings.
